name: Belbin Team Roles Inventory
description: Identifies nine team roles: Plant, Resource Investigator, Coordinator, Shaper, Monitor Evaluator, Teamworker, Implementer, Completer Finisher, and Specialist. Includes observer assessments.
reputation: Widely used in team development; 60+ countries; free basic self-test available.
notes: Observer assessments must be paid; self-perception alone is less valid.
